name: _item.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  home-mosaic/_item.scss — the .home-mosaic-item card container: transitions,
//  hover/focus lift, featured shadow, and the living-tile border sheen ring
//  (mosaic-border-sheen keyframes + reduced-motion cuts).
//  Imported by home-mosaic.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// position / top / left / width / height are ALL set inline by JS.
.home-mosaic-item {
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: var(--space-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--color-white-raw);
  // Always dark — photo cards look wrong on a light background
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  container-type: inline-size; // enables cqw units for child text
  border: none;

  // Smooth transitions — JS changes inline styles, CSS animates them.
  // Desktop: all properties (height/top/left are non-composited but tolerable
  // at desktop GPU speeds).
  // Mobile: only GPU-composited properties — height/top/left transitions
  // trigger a layout recalc on EVERY frame, causing the animation freeze
  // reported on iOS and Android.
  transition:
    height 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    top 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    left 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 0.36s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 0.36s ease,
    opacity 0.3s ease,
    filter 0.3s ease;

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    // Drop layout-affecting properties — keep only compositor-thread properties
    transition:
      transform 0.36s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      opacity 0.3s ease;
  }

  &--featured {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-featured);
  }

  // Living tile edge — a hairline gradient ring (mask-composite cuts the
  // fill to border-width only) with a soft sheen slowly traveling the
  // perimeter. Transform-free: background-position drifts on a long loop,
  // cheap enough to run on every tile at once.
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
    padding: var(--space-hairline);
    background: linear-gradient(
      120deg,
      transparent 32%,
      var(--border-item-hover) 45%,
      var(--color-accent-contrast) 50%,
      var(--border-item-hover) 55%,
      transparent 68%
    );
    background-size: 300% 300%;
    -webkit-mask:
      linear-gradient(var(--color-white-raw) 0 0) content-box,
      linear-gradient(var(--color-white-raw) 0 0);
    -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
    mask:
      linear-gradient(var(--color-white-raw) 0 0) content-box,
      linear-gradient(var(--color-white-raw) 0 0);
    mask-composite: exclude;
    animation: mosaic-border-sheen 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  &:is(:hover, :focus-visible) {
    transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--space-sm))) scale(1.015);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-hover);
    z-index: 10;
    opacity: 1;
    filter: none;

    .home-mosaic-media {
      border-bottom-left-radius: 0;
      border-bottom-right-radius: 0;
    }

    .home-mosaic-img {
      transform: scale(1.07);
    }
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    @include focus-ring;
  }

  // While the title burns, the sheen ring would read as a second
  // competing hover effect — freeze + hide it for the burn's duration.
  &--burning::after {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

// Sheen drifts diagonally across the ring — alternate loop, slow and
// low-contrast, so the grid shimmers without flickering.
@keyframes mosaic-border-sheen {
  0% {
    background-position: 0% 0%;
  }

  100% {
    background-position: 100% 100%;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .home-mosaic-item::after {
    animation: none;
  }
}

// Shadow DOM: mirror the store-driven html.reduced-motion flag.
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .home-mosaic-item::after {
  animation: none;
}
